items.why: GET /v1/organizations/22289866 serves the new_name. I could not read any dated notice for this org: winner=, buyer= and bidder= each return 0 tenders (more=false). It is a review body, and /v1/tenders has no filter for review-body parties. So the verdict rests on the name text alone. The raw head is 'Vergabekammer Rheinland-Pfalz' + LF + 'bei dem Ministerium für Wirtschaft, Verkehr, Landwirtschaft und Weinbau'. Both lines are one designation (the chamber, then 'at the ministry'), not two fields such as a name and an address. Collapsing them gives the complete name of this review chamber with no stray line break, and it matches the rival print 'Vergabekammer Rheinland-Pfalz beim Ministerium ...' (newest 2026-09-01). Better than the raw head.

GET /v1/organizations/22661109 serves the new_name. winner= and bidder= return 0; buyer= returns 3 tenders. Tender 547533 (TED 00423127-2026, 2026-06-19), tender 484722 (00050439-2026, 2026-01-23) and tender 1036539 (00176979-2025, 2025-03-19) all print 'Szkoła Podstawowa nr 13 z Oddziałami Dwujęzycznymi' as Procedure-Buyer. That is the short form without the patron or town. The raw head (printed once, newest 2024-07-18) is the same school's full name split over two lines: '... Dwujęzycznymi' + LF + 'im. Jana III Sobieskiego w Tychach'. The second line is the patron and town of the same name, not another field, so the collapse adds no false text. It gives the complete proper name without the break. Better than the raw head.

GET /v1/organizations/22981989 serves the new_name. winner= and bidder= return 0; buyer= returns 5+ tenders. Tender 1071850 (TED 00115949-2026, 2026-02-18), tender 441573 (00112125-2026, 2026-02-17), tender 72613 (00027919-2026, 2026-01-15) and tender 848552 (00797221-2025, 2025-12-02) all print 'ZESPÓŁ SZKÓŁ CENTRUM KSZTAŁCENIA ROLNICZEGO IM. WŁADYSŁAWA STANISŁAWA REYMONTA W SOKOŁOWIE PODLASKIM'. Tender 898904 (00676251-2025, 2025-10-15) prints 'Zespół Szkół Centrum Kształcenia Rolniczego im. Wł. St. Reymonta w Sokołowie Podlaskim', exactly the new_name. So the collapse equals a real print of the same school. The raw head's second line ('im. Wł. St. Reymonta w Sokołowie Podlaskim') is the patron and town of the same name, so no fields were glued together. Better than the raw head with its literal line break.

GET /v1/organizations/23474998 serves the new_name. winner= and bidder= return 0; buyer= returns only 2 tenders, so 3 procedures do not exist for this org. Tender 1045248 (TED 00448995-2026, 2026-06-30) prints 'Zespół Szkół Centrum Kształcenia Rolniczego im. Wł. St. Reymonta w Dobryszycach' as Procedure-Buyer, Contract-Signatory and TenderEval/Receipt. Tender 1017612 (00053168-2026, 2026-01-23) prints the raw head 'Zespół Szkół Centrum Kształcenia Rolniczego' + LF + 'im. Władysława Stanisława Reymonta w Dobryszycach' (Buyer, AddInfo, TenderEval, TenderReceipt). The second line is the patron and town of the same name. The collapse gives the full unabbreviated school name with no line break and no glued field. Better than the raw head.

Serves 'Przedsiębiorstwo Techniki Sanitarnej ALBA Sp. z o.o.'. The two newest notices print ALBA on its own: 7962244 (2026-09-08) has 'PRZEDSIĘBIORSTWO TECHNIKI SANITARNEJ ALBA' and 278047 (2026-09-03, lots 7-9) has 'Przedsiębiorstwo Techniki Sanitarnej ALBA Sp. z o.o.'. The old head is consortium text. It was printed on 332584 (2026-07-20) and 338546 (2026-07-01) as 'Konsorcjum firm: 1) Przedsiębiorstwo Techniki Sanitarnej ALBA Sp. z o. o. – Lider konsorcjum 2) Miejskie Przedsiębiorstwo ... - Konsorcjant'. The NIP 6270011376 (Chorzów prefix) belongs to the leader ALBA, and 34 of 47 mentions spell ALBA alone. So the identifier is not a consortium's own, and the new name is better than the consortium text collapsed.

Serves 'Stadt Zeitz'. Every recent buyer notice prints exactly 'Stadt Zeitz': 52730 (2026-09-15), 953555 (2026-08-28, also as Contract-Signatory), 764034 (2026-08-28) and 429571 (2026-08-21). The old head collapsed reads 'Stadt Zeitz Der Oberbügermeister Altmarkt 1 06712 Zeitz'. That carries an organ line with a misspelling, a street and a postcode, and was last printed 2024-04-10. The new name is clearly better.

Serves 'Alexianer St. Hedwig-Kliniken Berlin GmbH'. Serves 'C&E Consulting und Engineering GmbH'. The later winner notices print exactly that: 45696 (2026-05-22), 219149 (2025-09-11) and 223357 (2024-06-07). The old head 'C&E Consulting und Engineering GmbH NL Berlin/Brandenburg' appears only on 140260 (2023-11-13), and the 'NL' suffix marks a branch (Niederlassung). The VAT ID DE160004118 denotes the company, so the company name is better than the branch form.

Serves 'Magistrat der Stadt Flörsheim am Main'. Recent buyer notices print exactly that: 635189 (2026-09-09, also as Contract-Signatory), 75646 (2026-09-09) and 805877 (2026-06-03). The old head adds a second line, 'Stadtbauamt - Vergabestelle', which names a department and its procurement office. It was last printed 2024-01-26. The new name is the entity itself, so it is better.

Serves 'TAKMA Tadeusz Tiuchty'. Serves 'Universitätsklinikum Würzburg'. The 2026 buyer notices print exactly that as Buyer, TenderReceipt and AddInfo: 282768 (2026-07-01), 1155943 (2026-06-29) and 879470 (2026-06-09). The statutory name is 'Universitätsklinikum Würzburg', which is what current notices print, so the new name is better.

Serves 'Campus Unity GmbH'. The old head is that name with the street and city glued on, so it is an address print. Newer notices print the clean name: 1158007 (2025-07-03, Goethe-Uni HISinOne EXA), 200412 (2024-10-10) and 297679 (2024-08-16) all print 'Campus Unity GmbH' on parties[] and bids[]. Only 8086 (2024-04-12) prints 'Campus Unity GmbH\nKurt-Schumacher-Straße 1\n63322 Rödermark'. Same company, address dropped.

Serves 'Heinz Lange Bauunternehmen GmbH'. The VAT DE140207696 belongs to the company, not the BG: later solo, non-BG awards on the same org print exactly 'Heinz Lange Bauunternehmen GmbH' (8573016 2026-09-18, 106156 2026-09-15, 720482 2026-05-11 Chemnitz Scheibenbachkanal).

Serves 'ATELIER 30 Architekten GmbH'. The old head was a team print, 'Atelier 30 Architekten GmbH, Kassel \nmit Landschaftsarchitekt GTL Michael Triebswetter...'. The new name is the printed spelling with the double space collapsed. Not a member-for-consortium case.

Serves 'Stadt Laage'. /v1/organizations/22722707 serves 'Landratsamt Rems-Murr-Kreis, Amt für Schulen, Bildung, Kultur'. /v1/organizations/22738452 serves 'Hellenic Cables S.A.'. As a bidder and winner, the newest notices print 'Hellenic Cables S.A.': 451260 (00175491-2026, 2026-03-13) and 59219 (00093696-2026, 2026-02-10). 8545576 (00413021-2025, 2025-06-26) prints 'Hellenic Cables SA', and 115293 (00215052-2025, 2025-04-03) prints 'HELLENIC CABLES S.A.'. /v1/organizations serves 'Landesanstalt für Landwirtschaft und Gartenbau Sachsen-Anhalt'. Only two procedures are listed (buyer role; winner and bidder lists are empty). The older tender 669773 (2024-10-04) printed the old head, which has the street address 'Strenzfelder Allee 22 06406 Bernburg' fused into the name. new_name is the complete proper name with the address removed, so it is better than the old head collapsed. The rival spelling with 'Sachsen-Anhalt' dropped is a truncation and was not chosen.

Served name is 'GE Medical Systems Polska Sp.z.o.o'. Tender 8562419 (award, 2026-10-02; lots 26 and 114 won, bids under notices 47152981 and 47154059) prints 'GE Medical Systems Polska Sp.z.o.o'. Served name is 'TECNOSTRADE S.r.l.'. Prints by date: tender 278592 (award, 2026-08-03, lot 9) 'TECNOSTRADE S.R.L.'; tender 951792 (2025-09-03, lot 4) 'TECNOSTRADE SRL'; tender 824472 (2025-04-09, lot 10) 'TECNOSTRADE S.r.l.'. So the identifier denotes Tecnostrade itself. new_name is its proper name, only a capitalisation variant of the newest print, and much better than the collapsed RTI string.

Nowy Świat 7 m 14, 00-496 Warszawa NIP 536-00-15-638 REGON 010757273' fused in. Tender 265727 (2026-05-04) prints 'Balton Sp. z o.o.'. Tender 184830 (2025-09-22 and 2025-09-23) prints 'Balton Sp.z.o.o'. Tender 332111 (2025-04-25) prints 'Balton Sp. z o.o.'. The newest notice prints new_name. It is the same company without the address and registry tail, so it is better than the collapsed head.

Served name is 'Klingenstadt Solingen'. It is the buyer in two procedures. The newest, tender 656550 (award v8, 2026-07-28; Procedure-Buyer, Contract-Signatory and other lot roles), prints 'Klingenstadt Solingen'. Tender 573607 (award, 2026-03-09) printed the old head: the city name followed by the department 'Stadtdienst 23 - Gebäudemanagement', 'vertreten durch den Oberbürgermeister' and the address 'Bonner Str. 100 42697 Solingen'. VAT ID DE120871761 belongs to the city, not the department, so new_name is the entity's own name as the newest notice prints it. It is better than the collapsed head.

GET /v1/organizations/30914521 serves 'PUBLIC SECTOR MEDIA LTD' (GBCOH14861405). The org appears only as a winner/bidder, never as a buyer, on 4 procedures, and I read all 4. Three of them print mention_name 'PUBLIC SECTOR MEDIA LTD' on parties[] and bids[].parties[]: 8631187 (005916-2026, 2026-01-22), 8630390 (004618-2026, 2026-01-20) and 8599250 (058284-2025, 2025-09-19). It is the better name.

GET /v1/organizations/31571858 serves 'Sedem Pharmacy Ltd'. The org appears only as a winner/bidder, never as a buyer. I read the 3 newest procedures plus 2 older ones. 8651980 (037249-2026, 2026-04-23) prints 'Sedem Pharmacy Ltd', as do 8816394 (035976-2026, 2026-04-21), 8691308 (018214-2025, 2025-04-30) and 8691302 (018202-2025, 2025-04-30). GET /v1/organizations/22292733 serves new_name. The newest Procedure-Buyer prints all show it word for word: 471852 (2026-05-06, 'Mein Justizpostfach'), 295225 (2026-05-06), 545323 (2025-10-21), 295663 (2025-01-31) and 1017927 (2024-12-19) each print 'Land Baden-Württemberg, vertreten durch das Ministerium der Justiz und für Migration Baden-Württemberg'. 373282 (2024-01-30) prints it without the comma. The identifier 08A556445 (BW 08 prefix) is used by the BW Justice Ministry alone on every other procedure, so it is BW's own identifier, not a consortium's. new_name is the complete current proper name.
